C01.title: SARS-CoV-2 origin (lab-related vs zoonotic)
documented_failures: Missing intermediate host / infected animal in market supply chain (SSCP argument; still no public smoking-gun host isolate).
WIV proximity + GOF history + early researcher illness reports cited as investigative leads (not legal adjudication).
IC split: CIA 2025 low-confidence research-related lean vs other IC/SAGO zoonotic weight — no consensus smoking gun.
contested_conclusions: SSCP majority staff: lab origin more likely — minority IC view + inference, not settled science.
Peer literature still supports zoonosis as weight-of-evidence for many virologists; no final adjudicated origin.
C01.primary_status: PARTIAL — CIA/SAGO/public oversight present; serology notebooks / full WIV records missing

C02.title: Proximal Origin / NIH influence narrative
documented_failures: FOIA/oversight record: Andersen et al. prompted after Fauci/Collins engagement; 'disprove lab' framing appears in emails.
Paper used publicly to discredit lab-leak as conspiracy while private doubts existed (process/comms failure).
contested_conclusions: Whether paper is 'fraud' or scientific judgment under pressure is contested; influence ≠ automatic scientific falsity.
C02.primary_status: STRONG on process FOIA; payment trail partial
C02.oa: Unpaywall OA PDF for Proximal Origin DOI 10.1038/s41591-020-0820-9

C03.title: EcoHealth / Daszak grant compliance & debarment
documented_failures: HHS debarment / ARM actions (operative administrative acts) for grant noncompliance / present responsibility.
Late year-5 reports and compliance issues documented in oversight productions.
contested_conclusions: Debarment ≠ proof of lab origin; process failure is independent of origin hypothesis.

C04.title: NIH FOIA culture / Morens / oversight stonewalling
documented_failures: Morens FOIA evasion culture documented in oversight releases (private email, delete/circumvent themes).
HHS production delays / selective releases as process failures (C11 overlap).

C05.title: Six-foot distancing scientific basis
documented_failures: Fauci TI: six-foot rule 'sort of just appeared' — not rigorous quantitative derivation as publicly sold.
Collins TI: limited empiric evidence themes.
contested_conclusions: Whether some distancing helped in some contexts remains open; absolute 'always useless' is overclaim.

C06.title: Mask guidance evolution
documented_failures: CDC/public guidance flip-flops (early discourage public masks → later mandates).
Evidence mixed by setting; absolute slogans fail LEO pack v2.1 (mixed/flip).
contested_conclusions: Net community benefit still debated by setting/quality; not 'always zero' or 'always decisive'.

C07.title: Lockdown collateral harms vs benefits
documented_failures: NAEP learning loss, excess non-COVID harms series are documented harm tracks.
contested_conclusions: Universal net 'always more harm than good' requires counterfactuals not fully adjudicated — CONTESTED.
C07.primary_status: PARTIAL — harms solid; net universal meta missing

C08.title: Cuomo March 25 nursing home directive
documented_failures: March 25 directive language (must/shall admit) documented; July 6 draft issues; data-reporting controversies.
contested_conclusions: Criminal adjudication of 'false statement' not established as primary in matrix — missing criminal_judgment.
C08.primary_status: PARTIAL — directive primary; criminal judgment missing

C09.title: WHO / IHR / China early performance
documented_failures: IHR notification failures / constrained joint study themes in public record.
contested_conclusions: Future treaty 'completely proven harm' is overclaim; lab-leak denial as settled is overclaim.
C09.leo_bounded: SOLID when bounded to early performance

C10.title: Pandemic relief fraud / improper payments
documented_failures: GAO UI improper payment / fraud estimate ranges; SBA OIG potential fraud scales — method-dependent billions.
contested_conclusions: Exact dollar totals vary by methodology; order-of-magnitude failure is documented.
C10.leo_slogan: SOLID if ranges not absolute single number

C11.title: HHS production delays / selective EcoHealth releases
documented_failures: Production delays and selective EcoHealth-related releases as process failures in oversight narrative.
